title: Nilpotent Faber–Krahn and Weyl asymptotic nodal-domain bound for closed equiregular sub-Riemannian manifolds
author: Rupert L. Frank; Bernard Helffer
work: On Courant and Pleijel theorems for sub-Riemannian Laplacians
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 12 (2025), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.307
difficulty_reason: Nilpotent pointwise models do not directly control small nodal domains uniformly across a varying sub-Riemannian manifold. The authors establish uniform energy comparison and continuity of the local Faber–Krahn constants, then use a controlled IMS partition to obtain a small-volume inequality involving their integrated density rather than a coarse infimum. Together with the new Sobolev nodal restriction, that local-to-global estimate supplies the nonroutine part of the nodal count beyond the precise prior kernel/Weyl foundations.
